resources.string: Listens briefly. Only a musical fingerprint is sent to Shazam, never the recording. Internet required.
Hold Search in the navigation bar to identify music around you, then play the result.
Only while this window is open: the microphone listens for a few seconds. A musical fingerprint, not recorded audio, is sent to Shazam. Internet is required.
Song recognition is disabled. Enable it in Preferences.
Allow microphone access to recognize music.
Recognition is unavailable right now. Check your connection and try again.
No match yet. Move closer to the music and try again.
Could not start the song. Try again in a moment.
Player buttons and menus move to the left. In fullscreen music, artwork moves to the right.
Hold Library in the navigation bar: a vertical menu opens. From top to bottom: History, Playlists, Watch later (Favorites for music), Downloads. Tap an icon to jump there; tap outside to close.
Consecutive videos played from the same playlist can appear in a single expandable card. This only changes the history view; it does not move or delete anything.
